audit.cache_policy: Unique per-request query nonce, no-cache/no-store headers, no local response reuse; response cache headers and SHA-256 recorded. Origin-generated caches cannot be forcibly purged by this public crawler.
audit.scope: Sitemap crawl plus linked category URLs without query strings or pagination.
limitations: Coverage is 406 sitemap URLs plus 22 current linked non-sitemap category paths; this is not a full link-graph crawl.
Missing alt attributes and explicitly empty alt text are now counted separately; old combined alt counts are not directly comparable.
Cache bypass prevents response reuse in this crawler; application-side generated caches cannot be purged through public HTTP requests.
Query-string and paginated category URLs were excluded from the linked-category pass.
External links, performance/Core Web Vitals, rendered/mobile behavior, structured data validation, and authenticated Odoo settings have not yet been audited.
Google indexation, traffic, rankings, and revenue data were not available.

issues.title: Linked category destinations return HTTP errors
issues.evidence: 14 currently linked category destinations returned HTTP errors. They occur across 405 distinct source URLs among 405 successful sitemap HTML responses. Per-destination source counts are listed below.
issues.recommended_fix: Update or remove the stale category destinations in the shared Odoo navigation/category menu; redirect only where a clear replacement exists. Retest every source template after the change.

issues.title: Linked category paths redirect to different URLs
issues.evidence: 8 of 22 linked category paths redirected before reaching a successful page.
issues.recommended_fix: Update shared Odoo menu and category links to use the final destination URLs and avoid unnecessary redirects.

issues.title: Duplicate title tags
issues.evidence: 1 exact duplicate-title groups affect 2 URLs. Review groups for genuinely distinct products; similar variants may have legitimate overlap.
issues.recommended_fix: Review each duplicate group and make titles specific to the product attributes that distinguish the pages.

issues.title: Sitemap contains URLs that redirect
issues.evidence: 2 sitemap entries redirect to other URLs.
issues.recommended_fix: Replace redirected sitemap entries with their final canonical destinations.

issues.title: HTML pages have no non-empty H1 heading
issues.evidence: 1 sitemap HTML pages have no non-empty H1.
issues.recommended_fix: Review each affected page template and add a descriptive visible heading where it improves page clarity.
